initial_variance.what: V0 = a (Z0 - b)^2 + c at 2212.10164v1 Section 4.2.1 (a 0.265, b 0.246, c 0.0001, the printed z0), against the printed V0 = 0.18 per year

R1.reading: Z0 = sum c_i z0_i, with (c_i, gamma_i) the geometric partition of 2107.01611 Appendix A for K(t) = t^(alpha - 1) / Gamma(alpha), alpha 0.51, n 10, x 3.92, and z0_i paired with c_i in the order of the partition (i = 1 the slowest factor)
text: 2212.10164v1 equation (2.1) and footnote 6: the same multi-factor approximation as [28], the same (c_i, gamma_i), Z_t = sum c_i Z^i_t, Z^i_0 = z0_i
2107.01611 equations (2.3) to (2.5), Appendix A (c_i, gamma_i in closed form, eta_i = x^(i - n/2)), and the caption of Figure C.6: Z0 := sum c_i z0_i
2107.01611 Appendix C.2: the same z0 and (a, b, c), with lambda 1.717, as the calibration of 10 September 2019; 2212.10164 prints lambda 1.7, which does not enter V0
2107.01611 Figure A.3: log c_i and log gamma_i increase with i, the order used here

R1_rounding.reading: R1 over every value the printed numbers round from: each z0_i within 0.0005 of its printed value, a within 0.0005, b within 0.0005, c within 0.00005; the interval of V0 that gives

text: none: 2107.01611 Appendix A has mu(dx) = x^(-alpha) / (Gamma(alpha) Gamma(1 - alpha)) dx, which is the kernel with 1 / Gamma(alpha)

R3.reading: R1 with z0 paired with the c_i in the reverse order (z0_1 with the fastest factor)
text: none: Figure A.3 of 2107.01611 orders the factors from the slowest to the fastest

initial_variance.rule_for_readings: every reading is computed and reported; a reading the text does not support is never adopted, whatever V0 it gives, and no reading is chosen because it gives 0.18
initial_variance.reported: the Z0 that would give V0 = 0.18 at the printed (a, b, c), descriptive only

no_arbitrage_bounds.what: replaces the step 1 bounds check, which had no Monte Carlo tolerance
